head: working-tree
subject: Bounded Envoy URI-template path matching and rewriting engine
change: Added a self-contained URI-template engine under src/grpc/xds/routing/template.zig. It compiles bounded match templates with *, **, {name}, {name=*}, {name=**}, {name=videos/*} and embedded variables such as {file}.vtt, matches the path with query and fragment removed, and captures named values without allocation. A companion rewrite compiler validates placeholders against the match variables and computes exact output lengths before writing into caller storage.

unit: src/grpc/xds/routing/template_tests.zig covers the three Envoy documentation examples, suffix ** captures, query/fragment stripping, embedded filename suffixes, duplicate/malformed template rejection, unknown rewrite variables, case sensitivity and the root path.

notes: The engine is not yet wired to RouteMatch.path_match_policy or RouteAction.path_rewrite_policy; that integration remains open.
